parameters.query:
WITH exact_event AS (
    SELECT
        internal_id,
        external_id,
        payload,
        processing_status
    FROM public.raw_events
    WHERE last_execution_id = $1
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

fallback_event AS (
    SELECT
        internal_id,
        external_id,
        payload,
        processing_status
    FROM public.raw_events
    WHERE processing_status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed')
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

selected_event AS (
    SELECT * FROM exact_event
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM fallback_event
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exact_event)
    LIMIT 1
),

lead_candidate AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN payload ->> 'lead_id' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN (payload ->> 'lead_id')::integer

            WHEN payload #>> '{deduplication,lead_id}' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN (payload #>> '{deduplication,lead_id}')::integer

            ELSE NULL
        END AS lead_id
    FROM selected_event
)

SELECT
    (SELECT internal_id FROM selected_event) AS event_id,
    (SELECT external_id FROM selected_event) AS external_id,
    (SELECT processing_status FROM selected_event) AS processing_status,
    (SELECT payload FROM selected_event) AS event_payload,
    (
        SELECT l.internal_id
        FROM lead_candidate c
        JOIN public.leads l
            ON l.internal_id = c.lead_id
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS lead_id;

WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE public.raw_events
    SET processing_status = 'failed',
        error_message = $2,
        last_failed_workflow = $3,
        last_failed_node = $4,
        last_error_at = NOW(),
        error_count = COALESCE(error_count, 0) + 1,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE internal_id = $1
    RETURNING
        internal_id,
        external_id,
        processing_status,
        error_count
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT internal_id FROM upd), $1) AS event_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT external_id FROM upd), NULL) AS external_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT processing_status FROM upd), 'not_updated') AS processing_status,
    COALESCE((SELECT error_count FROM upd), 0) AS error_count;

WITH valid_event AS (
    SELECT internal_id
    FROM public.raw_events
    WHERE internal_id = $1
    LIMIT 1
),

valid_lead AS (
    SELECT internal_id
    FROM public.leads
    WHERE internal_id = $2
    LIMIT 1
),

ins AS (
    INSERT INTO public.workflow_logs (
        event_id,
        lead_id,
        step_name,
        status,
        wf_message,
        workflow_name
    )
    VALUES (
        (SELECT internal_id FROM valid_event),
        (SELECT internal_id FROM valid_lead),
        'workflow error',
        'failed',
        $3,
        $4
    )
    RETURNING internal_id
)

SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT internal_id FROM ins), NULL) AS workflow_log_id;
